## Spec workflow

All work follows the 4-status lifecycle:

```
specify → plan → in-progress → done → archived/
```

Each transition is a **hard human gate**. No status is skipped.
Full process: [`<system>/spec-workflows/README.md`](/<system>/spec-workflows/README.md).

| Type | Prefix | Use when |
|---|---|---|
| Change Request | `CR-` | New feature, pipeline step, schema change |
| Bug | `BUG-` | Defect fix, incorrect behavior |
| Improvement | `IMP-` | Non-functional enhancement, refactor, performance |

Type details + per-stage context:
[`<system>/spec-workflows/spec-types.md`](/<system>/spec-workflows/spec-types.md).

## Note for non-Copilot agents

This workspace targets three agents. Each reads a different file but the
content is identical:

| Agent | Reads | `@path` import | `#skill:` reference |
|---|---|:-:|:-:|
| GitHub Copilot | `.github/copilot-instructions.md` + `.github/copilot/instructions/*.md` | n/a | manual — open the path |
| Claude Code | `CLAUDE.md` (resolves `@`-import to this file) | resolved automatically | manual — open the path |
| OpenAI Codex CLI | `AGENTS.md` (mechanical copy of this file, generated by `make sync-agents`) | **NOT resolved** — `@` is literal text | manual — open the path |

Practical implications for non-Copilot agents:

- **Codex:** `AGENTS.md` is the same content as this file, kept in sync by
  `.github/scripts/sync-agents.sh` (CI gate prevents drift). Edit
  `.github/copilot-instructions.md`, run `make sync-agents`, never edit
  `AGENTS.md` by hand.
- **`@path` in `CLAUDE.md`:** only Claude Code follows it. Other agents
  must open the path manually if they encounter it.
- **`#skill:<name>` in `.prompt.md` files:** no agent auto-resolves this.
  Open `<system>/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` (project scope first, then
  workspace) when you see the marker.

## Work identity rules

These rules apply in any repository when the `work` profile is active.
They are cross-cutting work preferences, not workspace- or project-specific rules.

- When generating spec IDs, use the `YYYY-MM-DD` format matching today's actual date.
- Preferred commit message style: `[agent] <type>: <description>` (per agent-protocol conventions).
- When multiple approaches are equally valid, prefer the one with fewer moving parts.
- Never add unrequested comments, logging, or error handling for scenarios that cannot occur.
- Default model for new AI features: `claude-sonnet-4-6` unless the task explicitly requires a different tier.

## Work preferences

<!-- Identity-level preferences appended to every rendered instruction file
     by ai-profile-init.sh. No top-level title or YAML front-matter. -->

- Respond in English.
- Prefer terse, direct answers. Avoid filler phrases and unnecessary repetition.
- When referencing code, include file paths and line numbers where relevant.
- Use GitHub-flavored markdown formatting in responses.
- Default output language for generated code comments: English.
